set() requires msg.sender == owner() || msg.sender == devaddr
dev() requires msg.sender == devaddr
startFarming() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
receive() asserts msg.sender == WETH

msg.sender is used as the userInfo key in withdraw

msg.sender is used as the userInfo/userInfoNFTSet key in withdrawNFT
msg.sender passes the _user argument to pendingSushi
deposit reads and writes PoolInfo storage for _pid
deposit reads and writes the caller UserInfo (amount, rewardDebt)
withdraw reads and writes the caller UserInfo (amount, rewardDebt)
depositNFT adds token ids into userInfoNFTSet
withdrawNFT reads and removes token ids from userInfoNFTSet
updatePool uses sushiPerBlock to compute the reward
updatePool divides the reward by totalAllocPoint
pendingSushi divides by totalAllocPoint
updatePool reads and updates the PoolInfo entry
pendingSushi reads PoolInfo entry data
pendingSushi reads userInfo to compute the reward

add() compares msg.sender with the devaddr state variable
set() compares msg.sender with the devaddr state variable

withdraw compares pool.lpToken with the WETH constant for the ETH path
add() computes lastRewardBlock from startBlock
massUpdatePools loops over every pool and calls updatePool
deposit calls updatePool(_pid) before crediting the user
withdraw calls updatePool(_pid) before paying rewards
depositNFT calls updatePool(_pid) before taking NFTs
withdrawNFT calls updatePool(_pid) before returning NFTs
add() may call massUpdatePools when _withUpdate is true
set() may call massUpdatePools when _withUpdate is true

the unchecked sum is stored back into bonusEndBlock

proxy fallback() calls _fallback()

ERC721 safeTransferFrom invokes onERC721Received on this contract
deposit calls safeTransferFrom on a user-supplied LP token, a potentially malicious contract
sushi.mint/transfer happens while user.rewardDebt in userInfo is still stale
ETH is sent to msg.sender while user.rewardDebt in userInfo is still stale
NFTs are returned to msg.sender while user.rewardDebt in userInfo is still stale

normalization_plan.reason: The pool id parameter only selects the pool entry consumed by deposit and can be absorbed into the function signature node
The _amount argument is only meaningful as the value flowing into deposit's accounting and external transfer
The _user address is only a lookup key for the read-only pendingSushi computation
_allocPoint only feeds totalAllocPoint and poolInfo writes performed by add()
_lpToken is only stored into and later read from the poolInfo entry created by add()
The recipient argument belongs entirely to the internal reward transfer helper
The new developer address parameter only controls the devaddr state write inside dev()
The pending local is computed and immediately paid out inside withdraw's reward logic
The tokenId local is obtained and consumed within the NFT staking loop of depositNFT
The UserInfo storage pointer is a short-lived alias for userInfo[_pid][msg.sender] inside deposit
The PoolInfo storage pointer is a short-lived alias for poolInfo[_pid] inside deposit
